title: Multi-bitrate JPEG compression perceptual evaluation dataset 2023
summary: Use the mucped23 IQA database — human perceptual evaluations of images compressed with MozJPEG, libjpeg-turbo, and the jpegli encoder over CID22-derived 512x512 sources — to drive Meridian's JPEG-encoder selection and quality-per-byte tuning for image-heavy products.
